datasets.reason: No machine-readable table of Hellings-Downs angular cross-correlation (rho vs angular separation, with errors) was found. The NANOGrav 15yr Figure 1 data release (nanograv/15yr_stochastic_analysis, data_release/figure_1/) provides only: (a) posterior MCMC chains for amplitude/gamma (not angle-binned correlation), and (b) a notebook (upper_right.ipynb) that COMPUTES the binned pair-correlation from raw pulsar timing-residual data (requires a ~GB Google Drive download + enterprise/enterprise_extensions pipeline + ~18 minutes of covariance computation) rather than shipping a ready angle-vs-correlation table. Per ground rules, this pipeline output was NOT reconstructed/digitised here.

datasets.query: SELECT ra,dec,z,zErr FROM SpecObj WHERE class='GALAXY' AND zWarning=0 AND z BETWEEN 0.02 AND 0.12 AND ra BETWEEN 140 AND 220 AND dec BETWEEN 0 AND 50
datasets.row_cap_check: Full-query row count (193538 lines incl. 2 header lines) matches the independent SELECT COUNT(*) result (193536) exactly; no SkyServer row-cap truncation was hit, so no RA-strip paging was needed for this patch.
datasets.licence_citation: SDSS DR17 — Sloan Digital Sky Survey, public data release, Abdurro'uf et al. 2022, ApJS 259, 35
datasets.description: SDSS DR17 SpecObj spectroscopic galaxy sample (RA, Dec, z, zErr) in a contiguous patch (ra 140-220 deg, dec 0-50 deg, 0.02<=z<=0.12) for cosmic-web TDA.

datasets.source: Derived (not fetched) from sdss_dr17_cosmic_web_galaxies: same RA,Dec footprint, z (and paired zErr) independently permuted
datasets.method: numpy.random.default_rng(seed=20260919).permutation applied jointly to z and zErr; RA,Dec kept exactly as observed (preserves angular selection function/mask; destroys 3-D clustering). Full method documented in cosmic_web/make_random_catalogue.py.
datasets.description: Random comparison catalogue for cosmic-web TDA null test, built by shuffling redshifts on the real survey footprint (task-permitted construction; angular mask proxy).
